description: Landing pages — full CRUD (the audit's biggest gap). Add updateLandingPage + deleteLandingPage server actions, a dashboard detail route, an edit route reusing AiHtmlEditor, and fix the list to point at the in-dashboard detail with a Title-Case label. Independent of the other features. Build CLEAN in the semantic design system — do NOT copy the raw-Tailwind templates/[id] detail screen.
steps: In src/app/dashboard/landing-pages/actions.ts add `updateLandingPage(formData)`: 'use server'; read id, name, urlSlug, htmlContent; `const supabase = await createClient()`; get user, redirect('/login') if none; safe-slugify exactly like createLandingPage (urlSlug.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9-]/g,'-')); run `.from('landing_pages').update({ name, url_slug: safeSlug, html_content: htmlContent }).eq('id', id).eq('user_id', user.id)`; if the error code is '23505' (unique(user_id,url_slug) violation) throw new Error('A landing page with that URL slug already exists. Choose a different slug.'); on other errors throw a generic failure; then revalidatePath('/dashboard/landing-pages'), revalidatePath(`/dashboard/landing-pages/${id}`), redirect(`/dashboard/landing-pages/${id}`).

In the same actions.ts add `deleteLandingPage(id: string)`: 'use server'; auth with redirect('/login'); `.from('landing_pages').delete().eq('id', id).eq('user_id', user.id)`; throw on error; revalidatePath('/dashboard/landing-pages'); redirect('/dashboard/landing-pages').

Create src/app/dashboard/landing-pages/[id]/page.tsx (async server component) built in the SEMANTIC system. Await params; `const supabase = await createClient()`; get user, redirect('/login') if none; load `.from('landing_pages').select('*').eq('id', id).eq('user_id', user.id).single()`; notFound() if missing. Render .content-page + .page-heading (eyebrow 'Landing Pages', page.name as <h1>, metadata line `/l/{page.url_slug}` and Created date). Actions row: Edit <Link> to `/dashboard/landing-pages/${id}/edit` (.button.secondary); a Delete control as a <form action={deleteLandingPage.bind(null, page.id)}> with <SubmitButton label='Delete' className='button secondary' confirmMessage='Delete this landing page? This cannot be undone.' />; and an external <a href={`/l/${page.url_slug}`} target='_blank' rel='noreferrer'> link to view the public page. Below, a .data-panel containing a sandboxed preview: <iframe title='Preview' srcDoc={page.html_content} sandbox='' /> (KEEP sandbox=''). Use only semantic classes — no indigo-*/gray-* Tailwind.

Create src/app/dashboard/landing-pages/[id]/edit/page.tsx (thin async server component mirroring templates/[id]/edit/page.tsx): await params; `const supabase = await createClient()`; get user, redirect('/login') if none; load the page owner-scoped (.eq('id',id).eq('user_id',user.id).single()); notFound() if missing; render .content-page + .page-heading with a back <Link className='eyebrow'> to '/dashboard/landing-pages' and <EditLandingPageForm page={{ id, name, url_slug, html_content }} />.

Create src/app/dashboard/landing-pages/[id]/edit/EditLandingPageForm.tsx ('use client', mirror EditTemplateForm.tsx): import updateLandingPage from '../../actions', AiHtmlEditor, SubmitButton; useState html seeded from page.html_content; render
with a hidden ; ; the settings slot mirrors the create page: .settings-title block, a 'Page name' field , a 'URL slug' field using the .slug-input markup (/l/), the .studio-safety note, a Cancel to '/dashboard/landing-pages', and . No auto-save.

Fix src/app/dashboard/landing-pages/page.tsx: change each item's href from `/l/${page.url_slug}` to `/dashboard/landing-pages/${page.id}`; change createLabel to 'New Landing Page' and the CreateResourceDialog label prop to 'New Landing Page' (Title Case).
acceptance_criteria: updateLandingPage and deleteLandingPage both filter by .eq('user_id', user.id) and exist in landing-pages/actions.ts.
A slug collision on update surfaces the friendly 'already exists' message, not a raw Postgres error.
`/dashboard/landing-pages/[id]` renders metadata + a sandboxed (sandbox='') srcDoc preview with Edit/Delete and a public-page link, using only semantic CSS classes.
`/dashboard/landing-pages/[id]/edit` reuses AiHtmlEditor with kind='landing' and textareaName='htmlContent' and does not auto-save.
The landing-pages list cards link to `/dashboard/landing-pages/[id]` and the create label is 'New Landing Page'.
npm run lint exits 0 and npm run build succeeds.
verification: Run `npm run build` — must complete with no TypeScript/build errors.
Manually confirm every new/edited DB call on landing_pages includes .eq('user_id', user.id) and every srcDoc preview keeps sandbox=''.
findings: Done. updateLandingPage + deleteLandingPage added to landing-pages/actions.ts, both owner-scoped (.eq('user_id', user.id)); update maps Postgres '23505' to the friendly slug-collision message. New semantic-system routes: /dashboard/landing-pages/[id] (detail: .content-page + .page-heading + .data-panel with a sandbox='' srcDoc preview inside .studio-preview; Edit link, View public page <a>, and a Delete <form action={deleteLandingPage.bind(null, page.id)}> using SubmitButton confirmMessage) and /dashboard/landing-pages/[id]/edit (thin server page + EditLandingPageForm client component reusing AiHtmlEditor kind='landing', textareaName='htmlContent', no auto-save). List cards now link to /dashboard/landing-pages/${id}; create label is 'New Landing Page'. Patterns for later features: (1) SubmitButton 'confirmMessage' gives a native confirm() on destructive form actions — reuse for group/campaign delete. (2) Delete server actions take a bound id arg via action.bind(null, id), not FormData. (3) Detail/edit pages must be owner-scoped with .eq('user_id', user.id).single() + notFound(); server pages redirect('/login') when no user. (4) The .studio-preview wrapper class gives the detail iframe its height (min-height 520px) — reuse for other srcDoc detail previews. lint exits 0, build succeeds.
